name: Cooling water system and cooling towers
description: Cooling water system and cooling towers

specifications.basis: Natural/forced-draft towers generally used unless river or lake water in sufficient quantity; cooling water usable down to about 40-50 C, below that chilled water or refrigeration is used
Each process cooler served in parallel; cooling water almost never flows through two coolers in series; blowdown upstream of tower, make-up plus biocide/corrosion/fouling inhibitors
